fine_lines.title: impressed vs impressive
fine_lines.explanation_ar: impressed تصف شعور الشخص (أنا معجب): I'm impressed. أما impressive فتصف الشيء الذي يثير الإعجاب: Your work is impressive.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Impressed" describes how a person feels. "Impressive" describes the thing that causes the feeling.

examples.sentence: I'm really impressed with your presentation.

fine_lines.title: mistake vs error
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد تقريبًا. error أكثر رسمية وتُستخدم في العمل والتقنية، وmistake أشيع في الكلام اليومي. نقول make a mistake.
fine_lines.explanation_en: They mean almost the same. "Error" is more formal; "mistake" is more common. We say "make a mistake".

examples.sentence: There was an error in the invoice.

expressions.example: Well done! The client is very happy.

expressions.phrase: You were in a difficult situation and you handled it well.
expressions.meaning_ar: كنت في موقف صعب وتعاملت معه بشكل جيد.
expressions.meaning_en: Praise how someone dealt with a problem.
expressions.example: You were in a difficult situation and you handled it well, Sami.
Great job on the sales report. I'm really impressed.

expressions.phrase: You remained calm, friendly and professional.
expressions.meaning_en: Explain why the work was good.
expressions.example: With that angry customer, you remained calm, friendly and professional.

expressions.meaning_en: Say that mistakes are normal, but should be fixed.
expressions.example: Mistakes happen, but we must learn from them.
The file is safe? What a relief!

grammar.title: Adverbs of manner: well
grammar.explanation_ar: لوصف طريقة القيام بالفعل نستخدم ظرفًا بعد الفعل. ظرف good هو well: You handled it well (وليس good). ومعظم الظروف الأخرى تُكوَّن بإضافة -ly: calm → calmly.
grammar.explanation_en: To describe how you do something, use an adverb after the verb. The adverb of "good" is "well": You handled it well (not "good"). Most others add -ly: calm → calmly.

grammar.title: remain / stay + adjective
grammar.explanation_ar: الأفعال remain وstay تأتي بعدها صفة (وليس ظرفًا): remain calm، stay friendly.
grammar.explanation_en: After "remain" and "stay" we use an adjective, not an adverb: remain calm, stay friendly.

questions.question: You handled it ___.
questions.explanation_en: Use the adverb "well" after the verb.
